canonical_orchestrator_design.name: Canonical Orchestrator
canonical_orchestrator_design.purpose: Coordination layer above MissionController+ExecutionEngine for goal acceptance, plan generation, approval gating, role coordination, and independent verification
canonical_orchestrator_design.scope: MINIMAL — only what P1+P2 cannot do alone

components.name: GoalDecomposer
components.purpose: Translate natural language goal → List[TaskSpec] for MissionController.define_mission()
components.implementation: IMPLEMENTER agent with planner context (no new agent type)

components.name: PlanApprovalGate
components.purpose: Present generated plan to owner for approval/revision

components.name: RoleCoordinator
components.purpose: Coordinate Thinker→Verifier roles for plan generation and independent verification
components.implementation: MissionController executes Thinker task, then Verifier task after execution

components.name: EventStreamer
components.purpose: SSE endpoint for canonical mission events
components.implementation: Thin FastAPI endpoint over MissionController event bus

explicitly_excluded: New agent types — reuse IMPLEMENTER/VERIFIER with context

integration_contract.output: EVIDENCED mission with full event trace, evidence chain, no false re-execution ledger

vertical_slice_mission.goal: Create a markdown report from 3 web sources
vertical_slice_mission.failure_injection: One web_search fails (tool_runtime_failure) → engine retry → if exhausted → replan
vertical_slice_mission.verification: Event trace reconstructable, no false re-execution, checkpoint/resume works
